Evidence before autopilot

Find work that fits the evidence of your career.

ApplyGuard keeps your profile and decisions in this browser. It turns your resume into an editable evidence ledger, ranks recent product roles transparently, and prepares—not submits—reviewable application packets.

Safety boundary: ApplyGuard never stores credentials, logs into a job board, uploads files to a job board, or submits an application. You retain final control.

  2. 2Find recent roles from public sources

02 · Recent job discovery

Use the boards you already trust.

ApplyGuard reads only job-alert emails that you explicitly label. It does not scrape LinkedIn, Naukri, IIMJobs, or Instahyre.

Primary inbox

Privacy and data

Your data is local to this browser.

Resume text, profile, job decisions, packets, and audit events are stored in local storage. Public job-feed requests are made from your browser. Clearing browser storage removes this data.
